description: The tools in mise.toml and the actions in .github/workflows, once a week. They only check the tap, never ship in it: minor and patch updates are grouped and merge themselves once dod is green and the release is three days old; majors wait for a review. The casks are not Renovate's: each app's release job updates its own.

packageRules.description: Whatever no other group takes, majors in their own, lands in one PR a week.
